SVM bundle.description: Loaded as CLEAN_MODEL (mask_svm_bundle.joblib) in api/server.py for /api/predict-crop and /api/recognize-all, and used in Streamlit.

Broad EpiSAM CNN.description: Saved as standalone PyTorch checkpoint. Not imported or served in api/server.py or inscriplens_app.py.

Hero CNN.description: Saved as standalone PyTorch checkpoint. Not imported or served in api/server.py or inscriplens_app.py.

Line U-Net.description: Saved as standalone PyTorch checkpoint. The running app derives candidate boxes via connected components (outputs/segment_candidates.py), not Line U-Net.

KittelLM.description: Saved as standalone PyTorch checkpoint. Not called during live recognition in api/server.py or inscriplens_app.py.

Binarizer_core multi-scale.description: binarizer_core.py supports --multiscale, but outputs/app_backend.py calls it via subprocess without --multiscale (runs default GPU single-scale).

Translation_core.description: Imported in api/server.py and exposed via POST /api/translate. However, frontend/src/App.jsx does not trigger /api/translate, and Streamlit marks translation unavailable.
